intent.proves: At least one list option name is translated into a language other than the default that has product rows.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Needs authenticated full-payload and scope parity measurement; descriptor existence alone is insufficient.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomFieldOptionTranslation t WHERE t.EcomFieldOptionTranslationLanguageID <> N'{lang}' AND ISNULL(t.EcomFieldOptionTranslationName, N'') <> N'' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductLanguageId = t.EcomFieldOptionTranslationLanguageID)
